### What is MICE Tourism?

M.I.C.E is an abbreviation for corporate Meetings, Incentive Tours, Corporate conferences, and Exhibitions. It is a pure business segment of the travel industry, with a defined scope of activity and audience. This segment of corporate travel is showing a trend of fast growth as the Indian economy drives itself at a fast pace. Even though the essence of a [MICE event management company](https://www.sostravelhouse.com/services/mice-event) needs to be better understood in India, there is a reasonable growth in the number of event management companies in India.

Mice Company's professional event manager and corporate travel agent ensure the customer to focus on their business functions instead of putting their heads into event planning, strategizing, and executing them. Arranging Corporate Travel Meetings, events, annual days and Incentive tours is not an art but a complete science. It is not just limited to making hotel bookings or business branding or arranging for Audiovisuals or entertainment but essentially stitching the entire event seamlessly so that the purpose and essence of the event are captured in its entirety.

Types of Event Management

As there are many diverse types of corporate meetings, company & annual days, and events, we are sharing a portfolio of a few of the many types of Corporate Tours and Meetings. It is always the endeavor of SOS Event managers to deliver the highest quality of event services. We deliver the best event Production, Corporate meetings and tours, annual days, and other company event management services to help provide a seamless and quality experience.

### Event Management Services in Delhi

An important function within a Professional MICE Company is to constantly engage their employees as well as their channel partners or end customers through holding company events like Annual Days, Sales Kickoffs, Dealer meetings, Product Launches, etc. So the question is: Why hire a MICE Company for corporate event management? Like any other professional service managing an event requires great organizational skills and a deep understanding of the various nuances to host a successful corporate event.

Bringing together different service providers so that it works like a well-oiled machine providing deliverables keeping in focus the budget and the purpose of an event. SOS Travel house a bespoke Top MICE Companies in Delhi: Leading MICE Tour Operators & [Corporate Event Planners](https://www.sostravelhouse.com/services/corporate-event) has been providing event management services to its clients in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Lucknow, Pune, Goa, Chandigarh and almost Pan India for the last 26 years.

### Best MICE Company in Delhi for Events Planning

What is the role of a Manager in MICE Company? More often than not people looking to hire either someone who does venue bookings or a vendor who is doing branding or Vendor for A.V., thinking that they could perform the task of the event managers themselves. Most of the time it is done with the belief that it would save costs, but the cost in terms of time invested, the additional pressure of performance and the dilution of key responsibilities of employees often do not augur for a favorable cost-benefit ratio. Treat Event management companies in Delhi as your partner not competition to get the best value for your spend.

A professional Event manager has deep knowledge of the complexities of managing a professional event and their resource pool and industry knowledge help in bringing together the different service providers to work as a cohesive team. So engaging a professional Event management team would involve hiring them from booking venues, setting up menus, guest engagement ideas including stage set up, entertainment options, Emcee, Sound and Light, collaterals for events, and logistic planning and Tour and Travel.

SOS Travel house, a [Tour Operator in Delhi](https://www.sostravelhouse.com/) with 26 years of experience in Tour Packages, Professional MICE Companies in Delhi: Event Management & MICE Tour Operators can provide their expertise and professional pool of Vendors and Hotel partners to help arrange a corporate event on a Pan India level. From conceptualization to delivering a seamless event keeping in mind customer Budgets and Experience, the SOS event management team handles more than 100 events every year and managed over 90,000 delegates over the years.
